decisions.reason: Builds directly on established coolant systems, enabling the firm to leverage related knowledge and improve the product.
Cleaning centrifuge draws on existing filtration and pumping expertise, supporting assimilation of early results and refinement.
Nozzle line extends existing coolant knowledge, and multiple models provide learning opportunities within the firm's absorptive capacity.
Scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the established conveying offer, so the firm can interpret results and refine it.
Magnetic belt chip conveyor builds on established conveying capabilities, allowing effective learning and improvement.
